review_method: Visual inspection of actual saved source/target Blender renders under identical cameras, lighting and material; geometry protection checked separately in validation.json.
observations: Whole-head front, quarter and side contours appear unchanged outside the lips; separate geometry checks confirm exact protected vertex preservation.
Lip projection is gently reduced; the existing lip rim remains visible and side-profile change is subtle. This is not a claim of completely removing the pout.
No obvious newly introduced vertical corrugations, steps or perioral grooves observed in the final amplitude-limited candidate, including grazing illumination.
limitations: Visual inspection does not prove global surface smoothness.
Fixed surrounding vertices do not guarantee identical perceived expression; final appearance awaits user assessment.
No physical printing or body fitting performed.
